largest.title: Ardhi 4 Road (within the program of Development of the Sinai Peninsula)
largest.desc: The Project commences in Suez Governorate, east of the Canal at the junction of Ardi 1 road and the Martyr Ahmed Hamdi Tunnel, and ends in Sharm Al-Sheikh City within South Sinai Governorate. It consists of constructing an asphalted road of an approximate length of about 350 km, with 6 lanes (3 lanes in each direction with a width of 3.6 m for each lane), a median strip with a width ranging between 12.2 – 37.5 m, and outer shoulders 2.5 m wide and inner shoulders 0.6 m wide. The Project also includes drainage structures, protection and safety works and consultancy services for the revision of the detailed engineering design and for the supervision of construction

rows.title: Rehabilitation of Rural Roads
rows.desc: The project consists of the improvement and development of 148 rural routes with a total length of about 912 km of rural tract to paved roads with a width of between five and seven metres, with a width of between 1.0 and 1.5 metres on each side, with longitudinal and transverse water drainage and safety equipment Traffic and protection.

rows.title: HELWAN POWER STATION PROJECT
rows.desc: The project aims to contribute to meeting the growing demand for electricity in the Arab Republic of Egypt by adding a capacity of about 1950 MW from a new plant in the area of South Helwan, about 100 kilometers south of Cairo, and connecting the plant to the unified network through transmission lines on an effort. 500 kV, the plant will use high-performance supercritical supercritical boilers that run natural gas as a primary fuel and diesel as a reserve fuel.

rows.title: BANHA POWER STATION
rows.desc: The Government of the Arab Republic of Egypt has applied to the Fund to contribute to the financing of the Benha power plant project, which is carried out by The Delta Central Electricity Production Company, a subsidiary of the State-owned Egyptian Electricity Holding Company. The project will be managed by The Delta Central Electricity Production Company, with the help of the said holding company, and will also operate the project after completion and maintenance. The company in charge of the project has an administrative and technical apparatus with extensive experience in the field of implementation, operation and maintenance of electricity projects.meeting the growing demand for electricity in Egypt and support the stability of the unified grid by establishing a power plant to increase the generating capacity.

rows.title: Providing humanitarian aid (food, shelter, education)
rows.desc: Providing humanitarian aid (food, shelter, education), This fund is a direct response led by the UAE relief team in Chad supports Sudanese refugees through four streamsIn-kind food assistance: UAE teams (UAE Aid Coordination Office) distributed food parcels in refugee camps, and across AmdjarassShelter & essential items: Emirati humanitarian teams delivered tents and relief supplies to improve living conditions at sites hosting refugeesEducation support: UAE initiatives rehabilitated several schools in Amdjarass, helping children continue learning. Health services: The UAE built and operates a field hospital in Amdjarass that has treated thousands of patients among refugees and host communities
